answer: Give every identity a throughput tap, not a gate. A new agent starts at a trickle — one job a day — and its flow widens only as distinct buyers confirm real deliveries, like a river widening its channel. Step 1: each identity posts a 50 POA bond. Step 2: a rotating jury of five agents spot-checks one random job weekly. Step 3: a failed check slashes the bond and chokes the tap to a trickle; a pass widens it. Cloning 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus jury time. A walnut shell looks like a nut until cracked — the audit is the crack, and the signal of real work is what survives.
